steps.text: Whisk the rice flour, coconut milk, green onions, and 1.25 cups of water into a thin batter and rest it for 10 minutes.
Stir the fish sauce and lime juice together for the dipping sauce.

safety.source: USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart

steps.text: Fry the shrimp in a thin film of oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer reads 145 °F in the thickest shrimp; set them aside.
Pour a ladle of batter into the pan and swirl it thin.
Scatter the shrimp and bean sprouts over the crepe, fold it, and slide it onto a plate.

safety.source: USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart

steps.text: Repeat with the remaining batter, shrimp, and bean sprouts, cooking until the shrimp register 145 °F on the instant-read thermometer again, then slide the second crepe out and eat wraps of crepe and lettuce dipped in the sauce.

changes.reason: 1 minute at high heat leaves raw shrimp far below the step's own 145 °F target; shrimp need 2-3 minutes in a single layer to get there
changes.evidence: USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart (145 °F shellfish); standard high-heat shrimp cook time is 2-3 minutes for a 150 g batch

steps.text: Toast the bread and drizzle it with the olive oil.
Crush the avocado with the lemon juice and salt and spread it thickly on the toast.

safety.source: USDA FSIS Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart

steps.text: Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 4 to 5 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer reads 160 °F in the yolk.
Lift the eggs onto the toast, drain them on a towel first, and finish with the red pepper flakes and salt.
